about: How many days before a government's fiscal year starts each step of its budget season falls: the executive's proposal, the body's public hearing and its vote. A local body takes the hearing and the vote on its first regular meeting on or after the day.
citation: ESTIMATED: GFOA, Best Practices: Budgeting (a proposed budget reaches the governing body about three months before the year and is adopted before it starts); NCSL, Fiscal Year and Budget Cycle (governors send budgets about five months ahead; legislatures pass them before the year); Congressional Budget Act of 1974 (the President's budget is due the first Monday of February; Congress's target is before October 1).
